name: Cinder
description: A friendly monitor for long-running jobs and schedulers, translated from the round-5 living flame drawing.

colour_descriptions.outline: Deep crimson boundary and flame edge outline.
colour_descriptions.feature: Ink colour for eyes and facial outlines.
colour_descriptions.eyelid: Charcoal lid cover on the mask.
colour_descriptions.flame: Saturated crimson flame body fill colour.
colour_descriptions.flame_tip: Deep ruby tip colour at flame apex.
colour_descriptions.core_warm: Warm amber base for mid flame layer.
colour_descriptions.core_light: Pale cream apex of inner flame.
colour_descriptions.blue_core: Electric blue core apex when thinking.
colour_descriptions.blue_pale: Pale cyan core tip when thinking.
colour_descriptions.mask_light: Charcoal violet upper mask gradient stop.
colour_descriptions.mask_dark: Deep charcoal lower mask gradient stop.
colour_descriptions.ember: Warm amber ember glow for brows, mouth and cracks.
colour_descriptions.eye_arc: Warm gold arc for happy smiling eyes.
colour_descriptions.mouth_in: Deep dark red inner mouth cavern.
colour_descriptions.blush: Warm orange blush on mask cheeks.
colour_descriptions.smoke: Muted grey-purple smoke puffs in worried mood.
colour_descriptions.sweat: Cyan sweat bead in worried mood.

face.description: Center of the charcoal face mask.

kit_definition.description: Cinder ember-lit eyes, brows and mouth on charcoal mask.

thinking.description: Thinking state with blue core flame.

happy.description: Happy flared flame with waving arm.

celebrating.description: Celebrating tall flared flame with both arms raised.

flare.description: The flame flares taller before settling.

note: Picked round-5 flame and charcoal mask. Exact held-mood flame controls and articulated arm points sampled from the restored source at t=1.1; each mood uses its own heat, lean, width and height, rather than substituting a rigid scale for flame deformation. Thinking keeps the blue core. Static worried smoke puffs preserve the source still. Gaps: continuous procedural geometry, per-frame harmonic motion, screen/additive compositing, particle sparks/smoke and the source whole-body glow within current limits. No dynamic simulation, built-in shipping or visual approval is implied.
